footprints.description: Amphenol FCI 10056847 right-angle 0.80 mm card-edge socket, 20 contacts, SMT (2 rows of 10, rows 8.20 mm apart)
footprints.note: Drawing ELX-DG-010299-1 (10056847 rev G, 20 POS), PDF datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10056847.pdf, sheet 2 'RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT, CONNECTOR MOUNTING SIDE' (+ sheet 1 plan view for the housing). Printed: pitch 0.80 (9*0.80=7.20 per row), pad 0.50 x 2.00 (20-0.50 wide, 20-2.00 long), row centres 8.20 apart (4.10 each side of the peg line), 2 holes dia 1.55 +-0.05 on the peg line 9.60 apart (1.40 from the first pad of pins 1-10 to the peg: pin 1 = 1.40 right of the left peg), the two rows offset by 0.40 (pin 20 is 0.40 left of pin 1). Drawing orientation (mounting-side view): pins 1-10 in the lower row (pin 1 left), pins 11-20 in the upper row (pin 20 left, pin 11 right), the card opening faces the lower (board-edge) side. The footprint is the drawing turned 180 degrees about the peg-line centre so that the card entry faces up (-y): pins 1-10 in the upper row running right to left (pin 1 at x=+3.40, pin 10 at x=-3.80), pins 11-20 in the lower row running left to right (pin 11 at x=-3.40, pin 20 at x=+3.80); each row is 0.20 off the peg-line centre (rows 0.40 apart in x: 3.40-(-3.80)=7.20 centred at -0.20, and -3.40..3.80 centred at +0.20) - encoded with a gap of 0.40 after 'pad 0' (shifts the whole side by 0.20). Origin: centre of the housing and of the peg line (housing 11.00 wide x 7.80 deep from sheet 1: plan width 11.00, side-view depth 7.80; pegs/holes at x=+-4.80 = 9.60/2, y=0 on the housing centre line, read from the plan view). Peg holes dia 1.55 are drawn as non-plated (the print does not say plated). Note: 'pins' in this print are 1..20 (rows 1-10 and 11-20).

footprints.description: PCI Express x16 card-edge socket, 1.00 mm pitch, vertical SMT, 164 contacts (A1-A82, B1-B82), Amphenol FCI Gen 4/5 vertical SMT
footprints.note: No land pattern in the own PDF (datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/ssio_pcie_gen4_gen5.pdf is a catalog; it says the connector is footprint compatible with PCIe Gen 1/2/3). Land pattern taken from the sibling drawing 10165968 rev A 'PCI Express Gen 6, SMT Type' (PDF datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10165968c.pdf, sheet 3 'RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT, PAD TYPE', 164 POSITION row of the table), assumed identical for the Gen 4/5 vertical SMT (catalog: 'footprint compatible with PCIe 3/2/1'). Printed: pitch 1.00, pad width 0.53 +-0.05, pad length 2.00 +-0.05, pad row centres 3.60 either side of the centre line (row A top, row B bottom, as seen from the top of the board with #A1/#B1 at the left), A1..A11 = 10 spaces at 1.00 (10.00), A12..A82 = DIM J = 70.00 (70 spaces), key: A11 to A12 = 3.00 (hole axis 1.65 right of A11 and 1.35 left of A12), so a gap of 3.00-1.00 = 2.00 after pad 11; A1 to A82 = 10+3+70 = 83.00; locating hole dia 1.2 +-0.05 on the centre line at A11+1.65 (axis of datum Z); tabs: rectangle 3.00 x 5.00 (2X 3.00 +-0.05, 2X 5.00 +-0.05) 1.50 beyond the end pad on each end (DIM H = 92.00 for 164 = 83.00 + 2*(1.50+3.00): the left tab spans A1-4.50..A1-1.50, the right A82+1.50..A82+4.50, centres at +-3.00 from the end pads); right tab has a dia 1.80 +-0.05 hole whose centre is 0.30 inside the tab's inner edge (DIM K = 73.15 from the key hole to that centre: 11.65+73.15 = 84.80 = 84.50+0.30). The two 3.00 x 5.00 rectangles are NOT drawn as pads: the print does not name them (hold-down solder pad or keep-out is unknown) and the right one is cut by the dia 1.80 hole (a pad and a hole would overlap, which the footprint loader refuses); the dia 1.80 and dia 1.20 holes are drawn non-plated (the print does not say plated). Origin: x centre of the 83.00 pad span (the layout is symmetric about it: tabs 1.50 beyond each end pad), y the centre line between the two pad rows; body: 89.00 long (DIM B for 164 in sibling drawing 10173133 sheet 1 table) x 5.80 wide (housing width in 10165968 sheet 1), centred.

footprints.description: Amphenol Cool Edge 1.00 mm PCIe card-edge socket, vertical SMT, 98 contacts (A/B rows)
footprints.note: No land pattern in the own PDF (ssio_cooledge_1_00mm.pdf is a catalog). Land pattern taken from the sibling drawing 10177636 rev 3 'PCIe COOL EDGE 6.0, SMT VERTICAL, ASSEMBLY - LATCH' (PRELIMINARY; PDF datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10177636.pdf, sheet 2 'RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT', 164 pins; the Cool Edge catalog lists CEE0 + 098/164/230 pins, so the same layout is assumed for the latch-less parts). Only the 164-pin layout is printed; 98 and 230 are the same pattern with A/B rows shortened/lengthened (the key between A11 and A12 is fixed in the PCIe CEM; N/2 pads per row), NOT printed. Printed (164): pitch 1.00 (PITCH), pad width 0.55 +-0.03, pad length 1.20 +-0.05 (outer-to-outer 6.00 +-0.05, inner-to-inner 3.60 +-0.05: (6.00-3.60)/2 = 1.20; row centres = +-(3.60/2+1.20/2) = +-2.40), A1..A11 10 spaces, A11 to A12 = 3.00 read from the drawing scale (the CEM key; a gap of 2.00 after pad 11), A1 to A82 = 83.00 (hole-to-hole 87.00 = 83.00 + 2*2.00), holes: dia 1.95 +-0.05 left at A1-2.00 and dia 1.65 +-0.05 right at A82+2.00, both 1.50 below the centre line (toward the B row); tabs 2.90 x 3.80 (2X 2.90 +-0.05, 2X 3.80 +-0.05) centred on the centre line, whose inner edge is 1.55 +-0.05 beyond the hole axis (so centre at the end pad -+5.00: A1-2.00-1.55-1.45 = A1-5.00, A82+2.00+1.55+1.45 = A82+5.00). Row A is the top row of the layout (A1 top left), B below. The 2.90 x 3.80 rectangles are not named (taken as hold-down solder pads, pin 0); holes drawn non-plated (the print does not say plated). Origin: x centre of the A1..A82 pad span (layout symmetric: holes +-2.00 beyond the end pads), y the centre line between the rows. Body: housing length 95.00 for 164 (sheet 1 overall 95.00, catalog: 'length 95mm, width 5.80') = N/2+13 (98: 62, 230: 128, extrapolated) x 5.80.

footprints.description: Amphenol Cool Edge Double Density 0.80 mm card-edge socket, vertical SMT, 284 contacts (4 rows)
footprints.note: Drawing C CEDX1XXX11XXXXX rev 11 'COOL EDGE DOUBLE DENSITY CONNECTOR 0.80MM PITCH, VERTICAL' (Amphenol customer drawing, PDF datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/ccedx1xxx11xxxxx.pdf), sheet 2 (76/112/148) and sheet 5 (248..428) 'RECOMMENDED CONNECTOR FOOTPRINT LAYOUT COMPONENT SIDE SHOWN', dim tables on sheets 1, 3, 4. The own PDF is the drawing itself. Printed: 4 pad rows (pad 0.50 +-0.03 wide x about 1.20 long, read off the drawing scale: the print gives 1.20 +-0.05 for the slot and the pads look the same); pitch 0.80 along x; a column holds 4 pins, pins 1,2,3,4 = rows 1..4 from the top (labels 1,2,3,4 at the left end, 145..148 at the end of the left block, 149..152 at the start of the right block); first pad column 2.00 from the slot axis (dim 'C' = 2.00 + 0.80*(last column) + 2.00 between the slot axes: N=76 -> 18.4, 148 -> 32.8, 248 -> 56.0, 284 -> 63.2, 392 -> 84.8, 428 -> 92.0, all equal to the table's C); row spacing from the centre line: 7.20 from the top slot row to the hole line and 2.65 from the hole line to the centre line => rows 1..4 at y = -4.55, -1.35, +1.35, +4.55 (outer rows 9.10 apart: 7.20+1.90, inner gap 1.50 between pad edges: 2.70-1.20); key: for N > 148 the pad block is split after pad column 37 (pins 145..148): pad 1 is 2.00 and pad 149 is 34.80 from the slot axis (dim 34.80), so pad 1 to pad 149 = 32.80 = 41 columns * 0.80, i.e. the right block starts at column 41 (pin 149) while pad 145 is column 36: pad 145 to pad 149 = 5 * 0.80 = 4.00, the 4 missing columns are the key. Slots: 4 plated slots at the slot axes (x = -C/2 and +C/2), y = -4.55 and +4.55: pad 2.40 x 1.30 (4X2.40, 4X1.30), slot 1.80 x 0.70 (4X1.80, 4X0.70), pin 0. NPTH holes: dia 1.05 +-0.03 at the left axis and dia 1.25 +-0.05 at the right axis, both on the hole line 2.65 below the centre line (y=+2.65). Origin: x midway between the slot axes (the housing is symmetric: B = C + 2.00), y the centre line of the 4 pad rows (the hole line is 2.65 below, 'component side shown' = seen from the top). Body: B = C + 2.00 (dim table B: 76 -> 20.4 ... 428 -> 94.0) x 11.50 (sheet 1). The pad length 1.20 and the slot sizes are read from the drawing scale where not printed as such; rowgen cannot express 4 pad rows, so the pads of this footprint were generated by a script from the arithmetic above (x = -C/2 + 2.00 + 0.80*column, pin = 4*(contiguous column index) + row) instead of by a rowgen row.

footprints.note: Drawing C CEDX1XXX11XXXXX rev 11 'COOL EDGE DOUBLE DENSITY CONNECTOR 0.80MM PITCH, VERTICAL' (Amphenol customer drawing, PDF datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/ccedx1xxx11xxxxx.pdf), sheet 2 (76/112/148) and sheet 5 (248..428) 'RECOMMENDED CONNECTOR FOOTPRINT LAYOUT COMPONENT SIDE SHOWN', dim tables on sheets 1, 3, 4. The own PDF of this line (ssio_dd_cooledge_0_80mm.pdf) is a catalog with no land pattern; the layout is taken from the sibling drawing of the same series (Cool Edge double density 0.80 mm) and assumed identical for the 1.60 mm and 2.36 mm card thickness variants. Printed: 4 pad rows (pad 0.50 +-0.03 wide x about 1.20 long, read off the drawing scale: the print gives 1.20 +-0.05 for the slot and the pads look the same); pitch 0.80 along x; a column holds 4 pins, pins 1,2,3,4 = rows 1..4 from the top (labels 1,2,3,4 at the left end, 145..148 at the end of the left block, 149..152 at the start of the right block); first pad column 2.00 from the slot axis (dim 'C' = 2.00 + 0.80*(last column) + 2.00 between the slot axes: N=76 -> 18.4, 148 -> 32.8, 248 -> 56.0, 284 -> 63.2, 392 -> 84.8, 428 -> 92.0, all equal to the table's C); row spacing from the centre line: 7.20 from the top slot row to the hole line and 2.65 from the hole line to the centre line => rows 1..4 at y = -4.55, -1.35, +1.35, +4.55 (outer rows 9.10 apart: 7.20+1.90, inner gap 1.50 between pad edges: 2.70-1.20); key: for N > 148 the pad block is split after pad column 37 (pins 145..148): pad 1 is 2.00 and pad 149 is 34.80 from the slot axis (dim 34.80), so pad 1 to pad 149 = 32.80 = 41 columns * 0.80, i.e. the right block starts at column 41 (pin 149) while pad 145 is column 36: pad 145 to pad 149 = 5 * 0.80 = 4.00, the 4 missing columns are the key. Slots: 4 plated slots at the slot axes (x = -C/2 and +C/2), y = -4.55 and +4.55: pad 2.40 x 1.30 (4X2.40, 4X1.30), slot 1.80 x 0.70 (4X1.80, 4X0.70), pin 0. NPTH holes: dia 1.05 +-0.03 at the left axis and dia 1.25 +-0.05 at the right axis, both on the hole line 2.65 below the centre line (y=+2.65). Origin: x midway between the slot axes (the housing is symmetric: B = C + 2.00), y the centre line of the 4 pad rows (the hole line is 2.65 below, 'component side shown' = seen from the top). Body: B = C + 2.00 (dim table B: 76 -> 20.4 ... 428 -> 94.0) x 11.50 (sheet 1). The pad length 1.20 and the slot sizes are read from the drawing scale where not printed as such; rowgen cannot express 4 pad rows, so the pads of this footprint were generated by a script from the arithmetic above (x = -C/2 + 2.00 + 0.80*column, pin = 4*(contiguous column index) + row) instead of by a rowgen row.
